messages:
amanda: heads-up — main is CI red after the poetry lock regen from #482. macOS wheel build is failing in the cryptography install step with an SSL certificate verify error. I can't repro locally on linux containers.

ci-bot: Build #3821 failed on macos-latest — exit code 1 — logs: https://ci.redwood/3821 (artifacts > build.log)

ryan: can you paste the failing snippet?

amanda: sure, pasted below. this is from the wheel build step:
```
Collecting cryptography==38.0.1
  Downloading cryptography-38.0.1-cp310-abi3-macosx_10_9_x86_64.whl (3.4 MB)
Installing collected packages: cryptography
  Running setup.py install for cryptography ... error
  ERROR: Could not fetch URL https://pypi.org/simple/cryptography/: There was a problem confirming the ssl certificate: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED
```

leo: hmm, that reads like a transient network/CA issue but only on macOS runners after lock regen is suspicious. Did the poetry regen change certifi/requests/urllib3 subdeps?

amanda: lockfile diff shows these notable bumps: urllib3 1.26.14 -> 2.1.0, httpx 0.24.1 -> 0.26.2, certifi stayed pinned but its transitive placement moved.

sarah: can we bisect the lockfile to find which transitive pin introduced the macos wheel failure? i'll need a volunteer to run the quick bisect script (takes ~10m). @ryan?

ryan: i can run it now. steps?

sarah: run `scripts/ci/bisect_lock.py --from=HEAD~5 --to=HEAD --target=macos-wheels` — it will create temporary commits and run macos job locally on GH Actions runner env. watch for the first bad commit.

ryan: running. starting at 16:34 UTC. will report back. :eyes:

ci-bot: Job queued: bisect-runner-7 (estimated 7m)

ryan: quick update — bisect found first bad rev at regen commit that bumped urllib3 to 2.x. when i re-ran that commit with a minimal constraint `urllib3<2` the macos wheel succeeded.

leo: good find. urllib3 2.x has some pyopenssl/ssl handshake behavior differences on older macOS images. sounds plausible.

amanda: ok temporary mitigation: pin urllib3<2 in pyproject and open a follow-up to coordinate upstream fix for macOS CI image or upgrade runner openssl. who wants to make the PR?

ryan: i'll open the PR with the constraint and include test notes + link to bisect output. PR will target main and include changelog entry and CI rerun.

amanda: thanks. after that we'll run a full pipeline and consider a dedicated ticket to audit macos images (openssl version). :thumbsup:

ryan: PR created: https://git.redwood/r/PR-1982 — includes lock regen with urllib3<2 and the bisect artifact in PR comment. requesting review from @leo @sarah

leo: reviewing now. quick lgtm after CI passes. :shipit:

sarah: filing the follow-up ticket for runner image audit: https://issues.redwood/ENG-6123 — linking this thread.

amanda: awesome, thanks everyone. i'll merge after CI turns green.
